seriesTitle: Turning Point: 9/11 and the War on Terror

episodes.title: The System Was Blinking Red
episodes.summary: Interviews and chilling archival recordings chronicle the chaos that unfolded during the 9/11 attacks, whose origins can be traced to the 1980s.

episodes.title: A Place of Danger
episodes.summary: Survivors recount the horrors they endured on 9/11. Immediately after the attacks, George W. Bush begins charting America's aggressive military response.

episodes.title: The Dark Side
episodes.summary: Learning the hijackers benefitted from gaps in US intelligence, the White House justifies a secret surveillance program and "enhanced interrogation."

episodes.title: The Good War
episodes.summary: With no cohesive strategy, the war in Afghanistan squanders early successes and backfires, fueling disillusionment, corruption and a Taliban resurgence.

episodes.title: Graveyard of Empires
episodes.summary: After two decades, the US aims to end its longest-ever war, but its withdrawal threatens to plunge Afghanistan back into repressive, bloody violence.
